speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the onset of your gait and limb ataxia, and have you experienced any other neurological symptoms such as vision changes or numbness?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has this ataxia developed gradually over months or years, or did it appear suddenly over days? Also, have you noticed any tremors, slurred speech, or difficulty swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and recent natalizumab use, I am concerned about progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML). REQUEST TEST: Brain_MRI

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI_Brain: Lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML). T1/T2 images showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of PML.

speaker: Doctor
text: The MRI findings confirm Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy, likely secondary to your natalizumab therapy. DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML)
